name: How do I know if my wood fence needs repair or replacement?
description: If only a few components are damaged, repair is suitable. If damage is widespread or structural, replacement may be more economical.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my wood fence needs repair or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repair and replacement depends on the extent of the damage. If only a few posts or pickets are affected, repair is typically a cost-effective solution. However, if more than 20-30% of your fence components are damaged, or if there's widespread rot, severe structural instability, or significant pest infestation, replacement might be more economical in the long run. A professional inspection can help determine the best course of action for your specific situation.
